name: Open Paws Frontend API - Subscribe Calendar Agencies FIXED

parameters.query:
WITH upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO subscribers (email, is_active, updated_at)
  VALUES ('{{ $json.email }}', TRUE, NOW())
  ON CONFLICT (email)
  DO UPDATE SET
    is_active = TRUE,
    updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING id, email
),
deleted_preferences AS (
  DELETE FROM subscriber_preferences
  WHERE subscriber_id = (SELECT id FROM upserted)
),
inserted_preferences AS (
  INSERT INTO subscriber_preferences (subscriber_id, agency_slug, topic, created_at)
  SELECT
    (SELECT id FROM upserted),
    prefs.agency_slug,
    prefs.topic,
    NOW()
  FROM (
    SELECT value AS agency_slug, NULL::text AS topic
    FROM jsonb_array_elements_text('{{ $json.agenciesJson }}'::jsonb)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT NULL::text AS agency_slug, value AS topic
    FROM jsonb_array_elements_text('{{ $json.topicsJson }}'::jsonb)
  ) prefs
  WHERE prefs.agency_slug IS NOT NULL OR prefs.topic IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  TRUE AS success,
  'Subscription saved successfully.' AS message,
  id AS subscriber_id,
  email
FROM upserted;

SELECT
  id,
  document_number,
  title,
  abstract,
  document_type,
  publication_date,
  agency,
  html_url,
  pdf_url,
  comment_url,
  matched_terms,
  strict_score,
  embedding_score,
  ai_decision,
  ai_relevance_status,
  ai_summary AS summary_plain_language,
  why_it_matters,
  actionability,
  recommended_action,
  talking_points AS suggested_talking_points,
  deadline,
  urgency,
  advocacy_relevance,
  deadline_sensitivity,
  verification_instructions,
  disclaimer,
  lookup_mode
FROM public.fr_documents
WHERE publication_date = '{{ $json.date }}'::date
  AND ai_decision = 'SEND'
  AND ai_relevance_status = 'RELEVANT'
ORDER BY publication_date DESC, title;
